title: Independent test of metavanadate-assisted hydroxyl activation
difficulty_reasons: The agent must construct and validate two organovanadate transition-state pathways from molecular fragments while independently selecting conformers and computational methods.

paper.title: Metavanadate-mediated hydroxyl activation enhances reaction efficiency in the carboxylative cyclization of propargyl alcohol with CO2

data.description: Self-contained SMILES, charge, multiplicity, reaction context and endpoint definitions for 2-methylbut-3-yn-2-ol, monomeric metavanadate and CO2.

required_deliverables.description: JSON report of validated pathway structures, barriers, coverage, provenance and conclusion.
